entities.summary: Brandon Michael Mann is an American former professional baseball pitcher and current bullpen coach for the Miami Marlins of Major League Baseball (MLB). He played in Nippon Professional Baseball (NPB) for the Yokohama BayStars/Yokohama DeNA BayStars and Chiba Lotte Marines, in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Texas Rangers, and in the Chinese Professional Baseball League (CPBL) for the Rakuten Monkeys.
